explication: MemSearch provides shared semantic memory for coding agents: plugins capture conversation turns into Markdown journals, the CLI indexes those files and serves search/expansion, and agents reuse recalled context across platforms. The runtime also includes transcript-based retrieval, live synchronization, optional reranking, durable-note maintenance, and memory-to-skill distillation. Core call edges use the supplied source index; plugin workflows and unsampled capabilities are included only where the README documents them.
